title: Backtotop
description: x-backtotop turns its host into a back-to-top control: hidden until the page has scrolled past threshold pixels, and a click scrolls the window smoothly to the top.

threshold.description: How far the page must scroll, in pixels, before the control shows (`x-backtotop--visible`).

_metadata.derivedFrom: navigation.js backtotop() — every property here is one the behavior reads
